nodes.name: test_runs_and_comparisons.py
nodes.summary: API tests for provider runs, agreement-counting comparisons, partial and unavailable outcomes, final answer selection, and keeping the chosen answer out of model input.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Fixture yielding a test client backed by zero-delay mock providers.

nodes.name: new_ticket
nodes.summary: Helper that creates a ticket and returns its id.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Helper that runs a provider on a ticket, asserts success, and returns the execution.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Helper that posts a comparison request for a Jev and a GPT execution.

nodes.name: test_run_endpoint_records_and_returns_the_execution
nodes.summary: Verifies a run returns a successful normalized execution and stores one record.

nodes.name: test_run_unknown_ticket_or_provider
nodes.summary: Verifies an unknown ticket returns 404 and an unknown provider returns 422.

nodes.name: test_run_without_mock_or_key_is_recorded_as_not_configured
nodes.summary: Verifies an OpenAI run without a key is stored as a failed execution with a not_configured error.

nodes.name: test_comparison_counts_agreement_and_links_both_runs
nodes.summary: Verifies a completed comparison computes per-field agreement, names no winner, and links both executions.

nodes.name: test_comparison_is_partial_when_one_provider_fails
nodes.summary: Verifies one failed run gives a Partial comparison with no agreement rate while keeping the successful result.

nodes.name: test_comparison_is_unavailable_when_both_fail
nodes.summary: Verifies the comparison status is Unavailable when both providers fail.

nodes.name: test_comparison_rejects_mismatched_runs
nodes.summary: Verifies comparisons reject runs from another ticket or the wrong provider, and unknown executions.

nodes.name: test_comparison_waits_for_running_executions
nodes.summary: Verifies comparing an execution that is still running returns 409.

nodes.name: answer_of
nodes.summary: Helper that extracts the five classification fields from an execution's normalized result.

nodes.name: choose
nodes.summary: Helper that submits a final classification, optionally naming the source execution.

nodes.name: test_final_answer_taken_unchanged_from_a_run_is_not_marked_edited
nodes.summary: Verifies an unchanged answer records its source run and is not marked manually edited.

nodes.name: test_final_answer_changed_after_choosing_a_run_is_marked_edited
nodes.summary: Verifies changing an answer selected from a run marks it manually edited while keeping the source.

nodes.name: test_final_answer_rejects_a_run_it_cannot_come_from
nodes.summary: Verifies missing, other-ticket, and failed source runs are rejected and no final answer is saved.

nodes.name: test_running_and_comparing_never_set_the_final_answer
nodes.summary: Verifies provider runs and comparisons leave the final classification unset.

nodes.name: test_the_chosen_final_answer_is_never_sent_to_a_model
nodes.summary: Verifies later provider input and redacted request payloads contain no final-answer fields.

nodes.name: test_settings.py
nodes.summary: Tests settings defaults, environment overrides, empty-value handling, secret masking, range validation, and that .env.example lists every setting.

nodes.name: test_defaults_need_no_env_file_or_api_keys
nodes.summary: Verifies settings load with local defaults and without any env file or API keys.

nodes.name: test_environment_overrides_defaults
nodes.summary: Verifies environment variables override defaults with type conversion.

nodes.name: test_empty_values_count_as_unset
nodes.summary: Verifies empty environment values read as not configured.

nodes.name: test_api_keys_never_appear_in_repr
nodes.summary: Verifies API keys are masked in the settings repr yet remain retrievable as secrets.

nodes.name: test_out_of_range_values_are_rejected
nodes.summary: Verifies out-of-range concurrency, threshold, and timeout values raise validation errors.

nodes.name: test_env_example_lists_every_setting
nodes.summary: Verifies .env.example variable names match the settings fields exactly.

nodes.name: test_shell_support.py
nodes.summary: Tests the CORS allow-list for the configured frontend origin and that provider status reports readiness without revealing API keys.

nodes.name: preflight
nodes.summary: Helper that sends a CORS preflight request to the tickets endpoint from a given origin.

nodes.name: test_cors_allows_only_the_configured_frontend_origin
nodes.summary: Verifies CORS approves the configured frontend origin and no other.

nodes.name: test_provider_status_reports_configured_without_revealing_keys
nodes.summary: Verifies provider status and labels reflect configuration while the key value stays out of the response.

nodes.name: test_taxonomy.py
nodes.summary: Tests that the canonical taxonomy matches the specification exactly, including enum values, valid category-subcategory pairs, and the taxonomy endpoint response.

nodes.name: test_taxonomy_matches_the_spec_exactly
nodes.summary: Verifies the taxonomy version, categories, and subcategories match the specification.

nodes.name: test_subcategory_names_are_unique_across_categories
nodes.summary: Verifies all 36 subcategory names are unique across categories.

nodes.name: test_enums_hold_the_canonical_values
nodes.summary: Parametrized check that each taxonomy enum holds its canonical values in order.

nodes.name: test_every_spec_pair_is_valid
nodes.summary: Parametrized check that every specified category-subcategory pair is accepted.

nodes.name: test_inconsistent_or_unknown_pairs_are_invalid
nodes.summary: Parametrized check that mismatched, unknown, or wrongly cased pairs are rejected.

nodes.name: test_taxonomy_endpoint_serves_the_same_values
nodes.summary: Verifies the taxonomy endpoint returns the specified version, categories, and enum lists.

nodes.name: test_tickets.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end API tests for ticket creation, updates, notes, classification, search, filtering, sorting, pagination, dependent-safe deletion, and database outage responses.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Fixture yielding a test client backed by the test database.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Helper that creates a ticket, asserts a 201 response, and returns its body.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Helper that saves a final classification and asserts success.

nodes.name: ids
nodes.summary: Helper that extracts ticket ids from a list response.

nodes.name: test_create_assigns_sequential_ids_and_defaults
nodes.summary: Verifies new tickets get sequential ids, default status, nested fields, and manual source.

nodes.name: test_ids_stay_unique_under_concurrent_creation
nodes.summary: Verifies concurrent id allocation yields unique sequential ticket ids.

nodes.name: test_get_returns_ticket_or_404
nodes.summary: Verifies fetching returns an existing ticket or 404.

nodes.name: test_invalid_input_is_rejected
nodes.summary: Verifies a malformed customer email is rejected with 422.

nodes.name: test_ticket_text_is_kept_exactly
nodes.summary: Verifies a description keeps its line breaks and surrounding spaces exactly as typed.

nodes.name: test_update_changes_only_given_fields
nodes.summary: Verifies a partial update changes only supplied fields and advances updated_at.

nodes.name: test_invalid_updates_are_rejected
nodes.summary: Parametrized check that null titles, unknown statuses, bad emails, and empty updates return 422.

nodes.name: test_update_unknown_ticket_is_404
nodes.summary: Verifies updating an unknown ticket returns 404.

nodes.name: test_notes_are_appended
nodes.summary: Verifies notes append in order with distinct ids and that blank notes are rejected.

nodes.name: test_manual_classification_is_stored_with_version
nodes.summary: Verifies a manual classification is stored as manually edited, with no source run and the taxonomy version.

nodes.name: test_inconsistent_classification_is_rejected
nodes.summary: Verifies a mismatched category-subcategory pair returns 422 and leaves the final classification unset.

nodes.name: test_search_matches_each_searchable_field
nodes.summary: Parametrized check that case-insensitive search finds a ticket by id, title, customer name, email, or order id.

nodes.name: test_search_treats_input_as_plain_text
nodes.summary: Verifies regex-like search input succeeds as plain text and matches nothing.

nodes.name: test_filters_by_status_category_and_priority
nodes.summary: Verifies list filters by status, category, and priority, and rejects an unknown priority.

nodes.name: test_sorts_by_created_date
nodes.summary: Verifies tickets sort newest first by default and oldest first on request.

nodes.name: test_sorts_by_priority_most_urgent_first_unclassified_last
nodes.summary: Verifies priority sorting orders most urgent first and places unclassified tickets last.

nodes.name: test_pagination_is_bounded
nodes.summary: Verifies pagination returns the right page and rejects out-of-range page parameters.

nodes.name: seed_dependents
nodes.summary: Helper that inserts a comparison, execution, and evaluation label for a ticket.

nodes.name: test_delete_removes_ticket_and_its_dependents_only
nodes.summary: Verifies deletion removes one ticket and its dependents while another ticket's records remain.

nodes.name: test_repeated_delete_is_safe
nodes.summary: Verifies deleting the same ticket twice returns 204 both times.

nodes.name: test_failed_dependent_delete_keeps_the_ticket
nodes.summary: Verifies a simulated dependent-delete failure keeps the ticket and that a retry completes the deletion.

nodes.name: test_ticket_endpoints_explain_when_database_is_down
nodes.summary: Verifies ticket endpoints return 503 with README guidance when MongoDB is unreachable.
